summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Stock Losses (Gestion des Pertes) feature. Fixed critical bug in StockMovementType enum missing 'loss' value. All backend API tests pass (16/17, 1 skipped). Frontend UI verified working correctly for all roles.

bugs_fixed.issue: StockMovementType enum missing 'loss' value causing 500 error on /api/stock/movements endpoint
bugs_fixed.root_cause: When a loss is validated, the code creates a stock movement with movement_type='loss', but this value was not in the StockMovementType enum

backend_api_tests: GET /api/stock/losses/reasons - Returns list of valid loss reasons (breakage, expiry, theft, counting_error, other)
POST /api/stock/losses - Admin can declare a loss
POST /api/stock/losses - Pharmacien can declare a loss
POST /api/stock/losses/{id}/validate (validate) - Admin can validate a loss
POST /api/stock/losses/{id}/validate (reject) - Admin can reject a loss with reason
GET /api/stock/losses/stats - Returns loss statistics with by_reason breakdown
Stock decreases after validation - Verified stock_before > stock_after
frontend_ui_tests: Navigation link 'Gestion des Pertes' visible for all roles (admin, pharmacien, caissier)
Stats cards display correctly (En attente, Pertes ce mois, Quantité perdue, Valeur perdue)
Tabs work correctly (En attente, Historique, Statistiques)
Declare loss modal opens with all required fields (Product, Quantity, Reason, Details, Notes)
Validate/Reject buttons visible ONLY for admin users
Validate/Reject buttons NOT visible for pharmacien (correct behavior)
Validation flow works - Toast shows 'Perte validée. Stock mis à jour: X → Y'
History tab shows filters (Statut, Motif, Date début, Date fin)
History tab shows status badges (Validée, En attente, Rejetée)
Statistics tab shows 'Répartition par motif' with progress bars

features_verified.stock_update: Stock decreases automatically after loss validation

critical_code_review_comments: The 'declared_by_name' field shows 'Unknown' in the UI - this may be a minor issue with user name retrieval during loss declaration
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_stock_losses.py - Created comprehensive test suite for stock losses

success_rate.backend: 94% (16/17 tests passed, 1 skipped due to no caissier shift)

seed_data_creation: Multiple test losses created during testing. Some validated, some rejected, some pending.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stock Losses feature fully tested and working. Key fix: Added 'loss' to StockMovementType enum in /app/backend/models/stock.py. All APIs work correctly. Role-based access verified - only admins can validate/reject losses. The 'declared_by_name' shows 'Unknown' which is a minor cosmetic issue.
mocked_api_note: No mocked APIs - all functionality is real
